what: The stock baseline: ldpc 2.4.1 BP+OSD-0 at its common settings (ms30: min-sum alpha 0.625, 30 iterations, OSD-0), single-shot latency through its Python decode() on one core of machine A's host, and the LER records that the stock comparisons of tuning/KNOWLEDGE.md section 5 and README.md use. eldpc's ms30 preset is bit-identical to this decoder, so its LER is stock's.

machine.host_setup: each timed process alone on one isolated CPU, bench mode as in the final bench

latency.decoder: ldpc 2.4.1 BpOsdDecoder (min-sum, parallel, OSD-0), Python decode(), one core
ldpc 2.4.1 BpOsdDecoder (min-sum, parallel, OSD-0), Python decode(), one core

latency_notes: each row one process over a fresh latency shot set; the ms30 rows were capped at 540 s, hence 7,103 shots on bb144 xyz; on bb144 z 2 of 20,000 shots have an all-zero syndrome and are not timed. On every timed shot the stock observables equal eldpc's at the same config.

ler.note: eldpc ms30 decode of 4 fresh sets of 1M shots; bit-identical to stock on the latency shots

ler.consistency: the five fresh-shot runs on the identical circuit are consistent with one rate (p 0.07)

computed.note: ratios used by the docs, computed from this record and the final bench (tools/results/final-bench/final-bench.json, A-stock a03125c3 p50 34.02 us) and the earlier C-ABI stock row of tuning/data/knob_facts.json: bench (cpu), 65.0 ms
